exec: pm.test('Array de pets', () => { const rows=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); rows.forEach(r => {pm.expect(r.petId).to.be.a('number');pm.expect(r.clinicId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('clinicId')));}); });

pm.test('Contrato de pesos', () => { const rows=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); rows.forEach(r => {pm.expect(['DETALHE','SUBTOTAL','TOTAL']).to.include(r.tipo);pm.expect(r.pesoKg).to.be.a('number');});if(rows.length) pm.expect(rows.filter(r=>r.tipo==='TOTAL')).to.have.lengthOf(1); });
